notes: The ASV repeats the complementizer that (t004, t027) for the single אֲשֶׁר governing all three purpose clauses, so both occurrences form one discontinuous unit under rule 25; the live competitor reads nor that as one coordinator-plus-subordinator rendering of the second waw under rule 55, which would leave the waw+לֹא fusion carrying two words.
The italic even (t036) is added: the verse's one object marker stands on צַמַּרְתָּם, which the ASV renders bare, and rule 16 forbids reaching across the clause for a marker.
Each neither/nor is its own waw-plus-negative fusion (rule 35), not one correlative pair on a single waw, so rule 14's correlative clause does not engage.
אֶרֶץ תַּחְתִּית is split as in 31.16 and 31.18: nether parts to the adjective, of the earth to the noun.
